pages.text: It is used to give colors to $(l:utility/dyeing_tool)Dyeing Tool$() and $(l:utility/dyeing_bone_meal)Dyeing Bone Meal$(). And in the future also for other items in same way like dyes in vanilla.$(br2)To make it you need to place a Water Bucket, Phantom Membrane and a dyeing ingredient according to $(l:colors_ingredients_list_category)List$().$(br)
$(br)One ingredient produces 64 pieces of dye. To color the tool, you need 32 pieces. It can also be used to refill the Dyeing Tool.$(br)
